result.instructions: Tools for Corsizio, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my classes start in the next two weeks, and how full are they?"; "List everyone registered for my Saturday workshop."; "Which attendees still owe a payment, excluding canceled ones?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Corsizio data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run corsizio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run corsizio_request_feature to record the request. Paid options: a 7-day pass ($5 once, no subscription, unlimited calls for 7 days) or Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year). When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run corsizio_upgrade (plan "pass", "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. corsizio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: corsizio_get_account
tools.title: Get account details
tools.description: Get the Corsizio account behind the API key: name, alias, time zone, currency, site URL, contact, and the configured locations, categories, age groups, genders, levels and price ranges (their ids are the filters for corsizio_list_events). Good first call. API: GET /account.

tools.name: corsizio_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List the account's events (classes, workshops, camps) with dates, location, prices and page URLs, newest start first by default. Only published events unless status says otherwise. Filter by status, date range, price range, category/location/age/gender/level id (from corsizio_get_account) or a name word. API: GET /events.

page.description: Page number (default 1). The reply's paging.more says whether another page exists.

order.description: Sort order; a leading - is descending (default -startDate).

date.description: Event start/end date range FROM:TO, YYYY-MM-DD, either side optional, e.g. 2026-06-01:2026-06-30 or :2026-12-31 or just 2026 (UTC).

price.description: Price range FROM:TO, e.g. 50:200, :300 (300 and under) or 1000 (1000 and over).

search.description: A word in the event name, or an exact event id.

include.description: Extra data, comma-separated: details, filters, stats, config.

expand.description: Replace ids with full objects, comma-separated: filters, instructors, account.

tools.name: corsizio_get_event
tools.title: Get event details
tools.description: Get one event in full: dates, location, ticket prices and early-bird prices, descriptions, max spots, contact and instructors. Use include=stats for registration counts. For the attendee list use corsizio_list_attendees with the event id (or corsizio_get_event_with_attendees). API: GET /events/{id}.

expand.description: Replace ids with full objects, comma-separated: filters, instructors, account.

tools.name: corsizio_get_event_with_attendees
tools.title: Get event with its attendees
tools.description: Get one event together with its attendees (and optionally each attendee's payment) in a single call. Returns personal data of registrants (names, emails, phones, notes); only use it when you need the roster, otherwise prefer corsizio_get_event or corsizio_list_attendees with a limit. API: GET /events/{id}?include=attendees[,payment].

with_payment.description: Also include each attendee's payment details (default false).

tools.name: corsizio_list_attendees
tools.title: List attendees (registrations)
tools.description: List attendee registrations across the account, or for one event (event filter): name, email, phone, status, registration answers and dates. Default status is active. Filter by status (e.g. owing,!canceled), created-date range, event id, coupon code or a search word (name, email, phone). Returns personal data. The API key needs the attendees permission. API: GET /attendees.

page.description: Page number (default 1). The reply's paging.more says whether another page exists.

status.description: Comma-separated statuses (default active): any, active, waiting, archived, deleted, manual, attended, absent, payment, paid, owing, early, deposit, offline, exempt, refunded, canceled. Prefix with ! to exclude, e.g. owing,!canceled.

date.description: Registration (created) date range FROM:TO, YYYY-MM-DD, either side optional (UTC).

event.description: Only this event's attendees (event id from corsizio_list_events).

coupon.description: Only attendees who used this coupon (the coupon code, as the vendor docs describe it).

search.description: A word in the attendee's name, email or phone, or an exact attendee id.

include.description: Extra data, comma-separated: payment, activity, details.

expand.description: Replace ids with full objects, comma-separated: event, account.

tools.name: corsizio_get_attendee
tools.title: Get attendee details
tools.description: Get one attendee registration in full: contact data, registration answers, internal remark, status, and with include=payment the amount, fees, taxes, refunds and transactions (card brand and last 4 digits). Returns personal data. The API key needs the attendees permission. API: GET /attendees/{id}.

include.description: Extra data, comma-separated: payment, activity, details.

expand.description: Replace ids with full objects, comma-separated: event, account.
